messages:
Zoe L: Hey team, day 3 onboard q: I have two small Notion pages (a "Ramp Checklist" and an "Oncall Cheat Sheet") that I want to combine into one team-editable quickstart. Where's the preferred location and flow to merge + make it editable by eng without losing comments/history?
Maya (DevEx): welcome Zoe :wave: Great question. Preferred location: Docs > eng > <team-name> > quickstarts (or playbooks). To preserve history/comments you should ask Docs Ops to transfer the original pages into your team space and then merge there.
Zoe L: If I just duplicate and copy content into a new page will that lose comments? I don't mind losing some edits but prefer to preserve important discussion threads.
Priya: duplicating loses page-level comments (they stay on original). Transfer preserves history. If the two originals are owned by different spaces we can still transfer both and then you can merge the content on the transferred copies.
Zoe L: ok makes sense. Any naming conventions for the merged page so it appears in the space nav and is discoverable?
Maya (DevEx): use kebab-case, lowercase, and prefix with `qs-` for quickstarts, e.g., `qs-oncall-quickstart`. Add page property `doc_kind = quickstart` and `template_status = candidate` if you think it should be promoted org-wide later. Also set Visibility = Team so it shows in the sidebar.
Zoe L: Nice. One more: I want to let the whole eng team edit but only allow leads to archive pages. How do we express that with groups?
Priya: use two groups: <team>@redwood.com as Can edit and <team>-leads@redwood.com as Can full access. On the page Share dialog invite both groups with appropriate roles. If you need stricter audit controls use Docs Ops and they'll set ACLs on the space.
Zoe L: I'm trying to Move the page into eng space but Notion shows "You don't have permission to move this page" error. Page id for the ramp checklist: 5d9c2a.
docs-ops: We can transfer this for you. Reply with "please transfer" and we'll open a ticket to preserve authorship and comments.
Zoe L: please transfer, thanks.
devex-bot: Ticket created DOC-1200: "Transfer: Ramp Checklist (5d9c2a) + Oncall Cheat Sheet -> Docs > eng > <team-name> (merge candidate)". Assignee: Docs Ops. Link: https://tickets.redwood.com/DOC-1200
Priya: FYI after transfer, if you want to keep a delta-friendly edit flow consider creating a small section at top "CHANGELOG" and use dated bullets so reviewers can see what changed. Also add an inline snippet like: ```note
Vault path: vault://teams/<team>/oncall
Never paste secrets in Notion
```
Zoe L: good call re: vault. I was also thinking about backing up the quickstart to our docs repo. Is there a supported export/sync flow?
Maya (DevEx): we don't have a one-click org-wide sync yet. Options: (1) Docs Ops can provision a read-only Notion integration and a small CI job that pulls and commits markdown exports (public parts only), (2) manual Export > Markdown & CSV and commit. For CI pulls we ask Docs Ops to create the integration to avoid over-scoped tokens. Open a ticket if you want Docs Ops to set it up.
Zoe L: please open the sync ticket too, want the quickstart in the repo for offline reference.
devex-bot: Ticket created DOC-1201: "Notion export/sync (read-only integration) for eng/<team>/quickstarts". Link: https://tickets.redwood.com/DOC-1201
Priya: small note: if you plan to export to Git, remove or redact any private snippets and replace with vault references. Notion export sometimes strips page properties so include a header block listing key props before exporting.
Zoe L: will do. Anything else I should do to promote it later to Templates?
Maya (DevEx): to promote: duplicate the merged page, move duplicate to Docs > Templates > Drafts, set `template_status = candidate`, add short rationale and example usage, then open a PR in the Templates tracker (link on Templates page). Docs/Design reviews candidates and may mark `template_status = approved`.
Zoe L: awesome, closing the loop. Thanks everyone for the quick help :tada:
